title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create one file and nothing else: `src/greeting.txt` containing the single line `hello from perpetua`. Report, do not change any other file.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n')"`
## Context
- goal: the loop goal in `.session/loop-state.json` (`goal.text`); this is its first half
- gate: `policy/evaluator/gate.py` checks the file; read it only if verification fails
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (create)
- `.session/loop-state.json` (goal text only)
